title: Generate sports-style footage with Seedance 2.0 in 4K to better preserve fast…
content:
Generate sports-style footage with Seedance 2.0 in 4K to better preserve fast motion and intense tackle/fight sequences without obvious AI artifacts  
Use Seedance 2.0-4K for motion-heavy, multi-player/crowd scenes and shots with multiple light sources to reduce breakdowns common in other models  
Test Seedance 2.0-4K across complex camera angles (drone wide stadium, low-angle kicks, close-up reactions, audience POV) to verify stability and avoid glitches  
Access Seedance 2.0-4K via the official BytePlus API (for developers/enterprises) or use it directly on the BytePlus Lumina platform to run your own tests
